title: Nearer, My God, to Thee
composition: words by Sarah Flower Adams (1841), music by Lowell Mason (1856); both public domain
credit: From The Army and Navy Hymnal, performed by Maria Kasper; released into the public domain on Wikimedia Commons.
lyrics: Nearer, my God, to Thee, nearer to Thee
E'en though it be a cross that raiseth me
Still all my song shall be
Nearer, my God, to Thee, nearer to Thee
